title: Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Java Backend Developer with strong expertise in designing and building scalable, secure, high-performance backend platforms. This is a backend-focused engineering role for someone who can own technical design, build robust Java microservices and APIs, make sound database and integration decisions, and solve complex distributed-systems problems.

The engineer will work closely with product, architecture, DevOps, QA, and frontend teams, while taking ownership of backend quality from design through production support. Modern senior Java backend roles commonly emphasize Java/Spring Boot microservices, event-driven design, API development, distributed systems, cloud deployment, and performance/reliability engineering.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.
* Own the technical design of backend services, including service boundaries, API contracts, data models, integration patterns, and non-functional requirements.
* Build scalable RESTful APIs and event-driven microservices for internal and external consumers.
* Participate actively in system-design and architecture discussions, translating business requirements into reliable and maintainable technical solutions.
* Design for scalability, availability, performance, resilience, security, observability, and operational supportability.
* Define and implement microservice communication patterns, including synchronous REST/gRPC calls and asynchronous messaging.
* Develop robust integrations with internal platforms, third-party systems, databases, message brokers, and external APIs.
* Design database schemas, optimize SQL queries, implement efficient data-access layers, and select suitable persistence strategies.
* Build automated unit, integration, contract, and API tests to ensure backend quality.
* Participate in code reviews, establish coding standards, and improve engineering practices across the team.
* Work with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, release readiness, and production monitoring.
* Investigate production incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement permanent fixes and preventive engineering measures.
* Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance on Java, backend design, API design, and engineering best practices.

Core Technical Skills

* 5 - 7 years of hands-on backend software development experience using Java.
* Strong expertise in
  **Java 11/17/21**
  , including collections, concurrency, streams, multithreading, JVM fundamentals, exception handling, and performance optimization.
* Strong hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate/JPA, Spring Security, and dependency injection.
* Proven experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs and backend microservices.
* Good understanding of API lifecycle management, versioning, pagination, validation, error handling, rate limiting, and backward compatibility.
* Strong knowledge of object-oriented design, SOLID principles, clean code, refactoring, and design patterns.
* Experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* Experience with NoSQL technologies such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Redis, or Elasticsearch.
* Strong knowledge of Git, pull requests, code reviews, and Agile delivery practices.
* Experience with Maven or Gradle, JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, and API-testing tools.

Advanced Backend & Design Skills

* Strong experience designing cloud-native, distributed, and microservices-based systems.
* Ability to define meaningful microservice boundaries, data ownership, service contracts, and integration patterns.
* Experience with event-driven architecture using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, or equivalent messaging platforms.
* Strong understanding of asynchronous processing, idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, eventual consistency, and failure-handling patterns.
* Experience with resilience patterns such as circuit breakers, timeouts, bulkheads, retry strategies, fallback mechanisms, and rate limiting.
* Knowledge of domain-driven design, domain modeling, bounded contexts, and domain events.
* Experience designing high-throughput, low-latency backend systems and optimizing JVM, database, API, and caching performance.
* Hands-on experience with caching technologies such as Redis, Caffeine, or Memcached.
* Strong understanding of database transaction management, indexing, query optimization, connection pooling, and data consistency.
* Experience designing secure APIs with OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, RBAC, encryption, secrets management, audit logging, and Spring Security.
* Ability to create technical design documents, sequence diagrams, data-flow diagrams, API specifications, and architecture proposals.

title: Lead Frontend Engineer
description:
**Role:Lead Frontend Engineer(8-12 Years)**

**Location:Bangalore**

**About Tekion:**

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years,

Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive

platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC), Automotive

Enterprise Cloud (AEC), and Auto Location motive Partner Cloud (APC). Tekion

connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless

platform. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia, and

Europe.

We are seeking a Lead Frontend Engineer to be the technical anchor for our frontend capability. This role goes beyond feature delivery; you will define the frontend architecture, establish the component design system, own the Next.js application structure, drive performance standards, and mentor senior and mid-level frontend engineers. You will build the most complex, data-intensive UI surfaces: real-time attribution dashboards, AI-powered campaign builders, and platform-embedded intelligence widgets, all in a React + Next.js stack integrated with Elasticsearch-powered search and streaming AI responses.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own and evolve the frontend architecture: Next.js App Router structure, component boundaries, state management strategy (Redux), and data-fetching patterns applying hexagonal UI principles where the component layer is decoupled from specific backend service contracts.
* Design and build the most technically complex UI surfaces: real-time attribution dashboards (streaming data), AI-powered campaign builder (LLM response streaming), Elasticsearch-backed customer search with faceted filtering, and platform-embedded opportunity cards.
* Define the component design system: Atomic component library, theming contracts, accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1), and Storybook-based documentation.
* Establish frontend performance standards: Core Web Vitals targets, bundle size budgets, SSR/SSG strategy with Next.js, lazy loading, and virtualisation for large data tables.
* Lead Next.js architecture decisions: App Router vs. Pages Router tradeoffs, RSC (React Server Components) applicability, streaming SSR for AI-generated content, and API route design.
* Integrate AI-native frontend patterns: streaming LLM responses into UI components, real-time score updates from Redis/Aerospike via SSE, and Elasticsearch typeahead search.
* Drive code quality through design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and frontend-specific engineering standards.
* Mentor senior and mid-level frontend engineers, setting the bar for component design, test coverage, and performance discipline.
* Collaborate closely with backend staff engineers to define API contracts and with designers to implement pixel-perfect, accessible UIs.

**Requirements:**

* 8+ years of frontend engineering experience with deep React and Next.js expertise in production systems.
* Mastery of Next.js 14+ App Router, React Server Components, streaming SSR, and static generation, knowing when to apply each pattern.
* Strong TypeScript expertise: type safety across component props, API contracts, Redux store shape, and server/client boundaries.
* Deep Redux expertise: slice design, selector optimisation, middleware patterns, and RTK Query for data fetching.
* Proven experience building data-intensive dashboards with real-time data (WebSocket, SSE, or polling) and chart libraries (Recharts, D3.js ).
* Experience integrating Elasticsearch-powered search UIs: typeahead, faceted search, and result ranking display.
* Strong frontend performance engineering: bundle analysis, code splitting, memoisation, virtualisation, and Core Web Vitals optimisation.
* Experience in establishing and maintaining component design systems with accessibility standards.
* Must have proven experience leading front-end development teams, mentoring engineers, and driving technical decisions to deliver high-quality solutions.
* Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar across a frontend team.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience streaming LLM/AI-generated content into React UI components (token streaming, partial rendering patterns).
* Familiarity with platform-embedded micro-frontend patterns (module federation or iframe-based embedding).
* Background in automotive retail, eCommerce analytics, or SaaS BI/reporting platforms.
* Experience with Storybook for component documentation and visual regression testing.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Back-End & Agentic AI
description:
At Securonix, we’re on a mission to secure the world by staying ahead of cyber threats, reinforcing all layers of our platform with AI capabilities. Our Securonix

“ThreatQ”

platform is a cyber threat intelligence (CTI) platform designed to help organizations collect, prioritize, analyze, and operationalize threat intelligence at scale. It acts as a centralized intelligence hub that integrates data from multiple internal and external sources, enabling security teams to turn raw threat data into actionable insights.

Securonix is proud to be a cybersecurity unicorn and featured in CRN's 2024 Security 100 list. Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the largest private equity firms with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. With a global footprint, we serve more than 1,000 customers worldwide, including 10% of the Fortune 100. Our network of 150+ partners and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale.

Join us as we redefine cybersecurity, innovate fearlessly, and grow together as one team.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead architecture and design for major platform capabilities, translating product and customer needs into pragmatic, secure, and scalable technical plans.
* Contribute to the evolution of ThreatQ’s service, data, and integration architecture, balancing near-term delivery with long-term operability and maintainability.
* Design for scale across high-volume threat data ingestion, enrichment, search, analysis, and operational workflows; identify and address performance and reliability constraints.
* Remain hands-on in implementation, including complex or high-impact changes, and establish a high bar for code quality, testing, observability, and operational readiness.
* Provide technical leadership across teams through design reviews, clear technical proposals, sound trade-off decisions, and alignment on shared engineering standards.
* Partner with product managers, security analysts, UX, security, and platform teams to clarify problems, define technical requirements, and deliver customer-focused outcomes.
* Improve system reliability and service ownership through capacity planning, performance analysis, incident learning, risk reduction, and lifecycle management.
* Guide the adoption of event-driven patterns, APIs, and cloud and on-prem deployment practices that support dependable integrations and customer environments.
* Mentor engineers and grow technical capability through feedback, pairing, knowledge sharing, and support for sound independent decision-making.

**Required Skills:**

* 10-12 years of professional software engineering experience and a bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated experience shaping architecture and delivering complex software across multiple services, teams, or product areas.
* Strong hands-on experience with PHP (including Laravel) and/or Python, and a solid grounding in object-oriented design and software engineering fundamentals.
* Experience designing and operating data-intensive systems using SQL and databases or search technologies such as MariaDB, MongoDB, Redis, and Solr.
* Working knowledge of front-end technologies such as React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, sufficient to contribute to full-stack design and delivery.
* Experience with distributed or microservices architectures, RESTful APIs, JSON, and asynchronous processing or messaging systems such as RabbitMQ.
* Experience with automated testing and quality practices using tools such as PHPUnit, pytest, or Jest.
* Experience with CI/CD, Git-based collaboration, containers, and production operations; familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience designing or supporting cloud infrastructure on AWS and infrastructure as code with Terraform; on-premises Kubernetes such as RKE2 is an advantage.
* Ability to communicate architectural choices and trade-offs clearly, build alignment across teams, and influence without relying on formal authority.
* Experience working in Agile product engineering environments.

**AI Tools & Agent Integration Experience:**

* Experience using AI-powered developer tools (e.g., coding assistants, internal copilots, workflow automation) to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and development efficiency.
* Experience designing, prototyping, and integrating AI agents and intelligent services into internal systems and customer-facing products.
* Experience collaborating with product, security, and platform teams to incorporate AI capabilities that meet enterprise requirements for reliability, security, and scalability.
* Experience mentoring or guiding engineers on effective use of AI tools, prompt engineering techniques, and practical evaluation of AI-driven features in production environments.

**Senior Flutter Architect & Lead Developer**
with 8 to 10 years of software engineering experience, specializing in cross-platform mobile architecture and high-performance application development.

In this role, you will act as the bridge between high-level system design and day-to-day code implementation. You will own the architectural foundation of our mobile applications, define scalable development patterns, write critical feature code, and guide mid-level engineers. * **Code Reviews & Governance:**
  Conduct rigorous code reviews, establish coding standards, and implement static analysis tools to maintain low technical debt.
* **Testing Standards:**
  Drive the implementation of comprehensive unit, widget, and integration testing frameworks.

**Collaboration & Mentorship**

* **Technical Guidance:**
  Mentor and upskill junior to mid-level mobile developers through pair programming, architectural walk-throughs, and code labs.
* **Cross-Functional Synergy:**
  Collaborate closely with Product, UI/UX, and Backend teams to scope out feature feasibility and translate product requirements into clean engineering milestones.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* **Experience:**
  6–8 years of professional software engineering experience, with at least
  **3–4+ years**
  dedicated to Flutter and Dart in production environments.
* **Framework Mastery:**
  Deep understanding of the Flutter rendering pipeline, widget lifecycle, asynchronous programming, and platform channels (iOS/Android native integration).
* **Architecture & Patterns:**
  Proven experience with Clean Architecture, MVVM, BLOC and scalable folder/module structuring.
* **DevOps & CI/CD:**
  Familiarity with automated build and deployment pipelines (Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Bitrise) for Google Play and Apple App Store distribution.
* **Monitoring & Tooling:**
  Experience integrating and debugging via crash reporting and performance monitoring tools (Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry).

**Preferred / Bonus Skills**

* Experience with multi-platform targets (Flutter Web or Desktop, Android, iOS).
* Contributions to open-source Flutter packages or active involvement in the mobile developer community.
* Exposure to backend technologies (Node.js, Firebase, or GraphQL) to better collaborate with API developers.

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
**Who are we looking for?**

We are hiring a technical owner for our in-house AI products. This is a mid-layer engineering role. You will own the products we have already built, upgrade them, take them through to deployment, and stay close enough to users that the product actually gets adopted.

You are a technical resource first. You write, review, and ship. You understand the stack, the models, the infra, and the business problem well enough to make the right build decisions yourself.

**What you will own**

* In-house AI products: architecture, upgrades, quality, and release until deployment
* Technical execution for AI development happening inside the company
* Software and hardware infrastructure the products run on (hosting, servers, environments, usage, cost, reliability)
* Product adoption from a technical side: rollout, stability, usability, and feedback into the next build

**What will be your key responsibilities?**

**Build, upgrade, deploy**

* Own development and upgrades from design through testing to production
* Work in the codebase: architecture, AI tooling, integrations, and release quality
* Definition of done is deployment. Code that is written but not live is not done
* Keep the product stable: fewer regressions, less leftover WIP, faster path from change to live

**Technical ownership**

* Own the in-house AI product(s) as a builder: what we ship, how it is built, and whether it holds up in production
* Turn business problems into technical solutions, not a list of tickets for someone else
* Make build vs buy vs ignore calls on AI tools, models, and frameworks

**Infrastructure**

* Stay hands-on with hosting, servers, environments, usage, and cost
* Size infra to the product. Reliability and spend are part of the job, not a side conversation
* Keep product decisions and server reality aligned

**AI and technology**

* Stay current on AI tools, models, frameworks, and how the market is moving
* Recommend what we should adopt, what we should skip, and what we should build ourselves
* Keep the stack current without chasing every new tool

**Adoption and business lens**

* Treat adoption as a core outcome. A product that is live but unused has failed
* Support internal rollout with a product that is stable, fast, and easy to use in real workflows
* Measure usage and drop-off, then feed that back into what you build next
* Entrepreneurial mindset: ownership, speed, trade-offs, and whether this makes the business better

**What are the key requirements for the role?**

* 4-6yrs of strong technical base: architecture, APIs, data flow, models, and deployment. You can build, not only describe
* Hands-on with AI products and the current AI toolchain (LLMs, embeddings, agents, evaluation, orchestration)
* Working knowledge of software and hardware/infra: hosting, servers, environments, basic networking and usage
* Experience taking a product from build to live yourself, ideally an internal tool or AI product in a services / professional-firm environment
* Cloud hosting, cost optimisation, and production monitoring experience
* Product sense with a business lens: adoption, value, and cost, not only shipping features
* Entrepreneurial mindset: ownership, bias to action, comfort with incomplete information
* Clear communicator with engineers and with the business
* Comfort helping people move from old workflows onto a new product
* Mid-level: you can run this without being managed day to day

title: Medical Visualization Engineer – 3D Rendering
description:
Key Responsibilities

* Develop interactive medical visualization applications for 2D images, multiplanar reconstruction, 3D surfaces, and volumetric datasets derived from CT, MR, ultrasound, or fluoroscopy workflows.
* Implement volume rendering, surface rendering, transfer functions, lighting, clipping, cropping, transparency, camera controls, and anatomical exploration features.
* Convert medical image volumes, segmentation masks, landmarks, centerlines, meshes, and quantitative results into accurate and intuitive 3D visual representations.
* Develop visualization features for segmentation overlays, measurements, annotations, registration results, treatment or intervention planning, and image-guided navigation.
* Implement geometry-processing workflows including isosurface extraction, mesh generation, smoothing, decimation, repair, normal computation, and model export.
* Optimize rendering pipelines for responsiveness, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and real-time interaction with large medical datasets.
* Work with DICOM datasets and support image loading, orientation handling, voxel spacing, coordinate transformations, metadata interpretation, and de-identification-aware workflows.
* Collaborate with AI and medical imaging teams to visualize model outputs, uncertainty, anatomical structures, and quantitative biomarkers for validation and demonstration.
* Conduct visual and functional testing to verify anatomical correctness, coordinate consistency, rendering quality, usability, and performance across representative datasets.
* Document visualization architecture, rendering methods, design assumptions, performance findings, and user-interface behavior.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Graphics, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Medical Imaging, Game Technology, or a related field.
* Less than 3 years of professional, research, internship, or project experience in computer graphics, scientific visualization, medical imaging, game-engine development, or 3D application development.
* Strong understanding of 3D graphics concepts including coordinate systems, transformations, cameras, lighting, textures, meshes, shaders, depth, transparency, and rendering pipelines.
* Hands-on programming experience in C++ and/or Python, with exposure to graphics or visualization frameworks.
* Experience with one or more tools or libraries such as VTK, OpenGL, WebGL, Three.js, Unity, Unreal Engine, DirectX, Vulkan, or similar technologies.
* Experience working with 3D geometry, point clouds, surface meshes, volumetric data, or image stacks.
* Familiarity with image-processing and medical-imaging tools such as OpenCV, SimpleITK, ITK, pydicom, NiBabel, MONAI, or 3D Slicer.
* Understanding of DICOM image orientation, voxel spacing, patient coordinate systems, resampling, and the relationship between image space and world space.
* Ability to profile and troubleshoot rendering performance, memory use, visual artifacts, and cross-platform behavior.
* Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with imaging scientists, AI engineers, clinicians, UX designers, and software developers.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with direct volume rendering, ray casting, transfer-function design, GPU shaders, CUDA, compute shaders, or GPU-accelerated image processing.
* Exposure to medical visualization workflows such as MPR, MIP, MinIP, curved planar reformation, cinematic rendering, segmentation review, surgical planning, or navigation.
* Familiarity with mesh-processing libraries such as Open3D, PCL, CGAL, trimesh, MeshLab, or similar frameworks.
* Experience creating interactive desktop, web, AR, VR, or mixed-reality applications for scientific or medical use cases.
* Basic understanding of human factors, visual perception, color mapping, accessibility, and clinical usability considerations.

Good to have

* Exposure to front-end development frameworks such as React, Angular, Qt, Flutter, or similar technologies for building visualization interfaces and proof-of-concept demos.
* Experience with DICOMweb, PACS integration concepts, image streaming, cloud-based rendering, or remote visualization.
* Awareness of regulatory, privacy, cybersecurity, and software-quality considerations for medical visualization applications, including traceability and reproducible validation.

title: Lead / Principal Engineer - Full Stack
description:
A different kind of organization
  
  

* High trust, transparency, and autonomy
* Small teams, high ownership, flat structures
* Radical compensation transparency
* Sense of ownership in collective success
* Work with exceptional people who deeply care about their craft

The role
  
  
As a Lead/Principal Engineer, you're often the first person a customer meets to brainstorm a business problem. You should be at home debating distributed systems with engineers and framing decisions with leadership. You'll frame the problem with customers, shape the approach with the team, provide technical direction, and stay hands-on through delivery. You will work in self-managing, experienced, small, and high-impact teams, solving hard problems. This is a consulting & tech delivery role and while you will not have direct reports, you will regularly influence teams, mentor practitioners, manage stakeholders, and guide organisations through complex technology and business decisions.
  
  
What the work looks like
  
  
We can't promise which problem you'll pick up, but the menu right now looks something like this:
  
  

* Redesign a ClickHouse schema so an ad buyer can query 85 billion rows in under two seconds, and discover that pre-exploding the rows 168x is actually the right answer.
* Keep a vehicle telemetry platform moving billions of messages a day without the Kafka consumers falling over.
* Build the engineering spine of a mobile wallet used by more than two billion people across four continents.
* Ship the data product behind peer-review submissions for one of the world's largest scientific publishers.

The list changes every quarter. The pattern doesn't: data-heavy, distributed, and often sitting on top of something that already exists and isn't perfect.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
Frame Problems & Propose Solutions
  
  

* Help customers find the right problem before jumping to a solution.
* Facilitate discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and technical workshops.
* Translate business goals into a technology strategy and an execution plan.

Lead Through Technical Excellence
  
  

* Stay hands-on; contribute directly to design, architecture, implementation, and review.
* Make pragmatic calls balancing business needs, engineering quality, and delivery timelines.
* Guide teams to build scalable, resilient, secure systems and the practices that keep them that way.

Influence, Advise, and align
  
  

* Act as a trusted advisor on technology and investment decisions; assessments, due diligence, advisory.
* Build trust and alignment across Sahaj and customer teams
* Converge competing priorities into a path forward.
* Communicate complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Shape new work through discovery and proposals; mentor others and raise the bar as you go.

Operate Across Technology Domains
  
  
Distributed systems, data engineering, AI & agentic systems, DevOps/SRE. Depth in few areas; breadth across, and appreciation for trade-offs in context.
  
  
You'll thrive here if
  
  

* You reach for the simplest solution that gets the job done and distrust accidental complexity.
* You think in systems, not isolated parts.
* You stay calm when the path is unclear and build clarity for those around you.
* You move easily between the org-level picture and the technical detail.
* You're curious by default and pick up new domains fast.
* You'd rather be in the room with a customer solving a real problem.

What we're looking for
  
  

* 14+ years building software systems in complex environments.
* Strong engineering fundamentals; expert in at least one language, ideally polyglot.
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering distributed systems at scale.
* Deep grasp of architecture, system design, and engineering trade-offs.
* Direct experience working with customers and business stakeholders.

title: Lead AI Engineer – Agentic Systems & Voice AI
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly experienced Lead AI Engineer to architect, deploy, and scale intelligent, agentic voice systems capable of handling massive production traffic. This role focuses on building ultra-low-latency, full-duplex conversational voice agents using cascaded architectures (ASR -> LLM -> TTS) tailored for Indian languages. You will act as the technical bridge between complex client workflows and scalable AI capabilities, ensuring robust backend execution, optimal resource efficiency, and seamless human-computer interaction at enterprise scale.

Core Responsibilities

* **Full-Duplex Voice Architecture:**
  Design and orchestrate conversational AI pipelines without relying on native multimodal/full-duplex LLMs. Build and tune highly responsive turn-taking logic, Voice Activity Detection (VAD), and barge-in/interruption handling across cascaded ASR, LLM, and TTS components.
* **Telephony & API Integration:**
  Seamlessly bridge AI inference pipelines with standard telephony APIs (Twilio, Plivo, Exotel) for inbound and outbound agent call flows, managing basic call state (transfers, hold, drop detection).
* **Agentic Workflow Orchestration:**
  Collaborate directly with clients to deconstruct complex business requirements and operational workflows. Translate these into deterministic agentic capabilities, utilizing state machines, tool-calling, and external API integrations to execute multi-step reasoning tasks.
* **Latency & Efficiency Optimization:**
  Drive hardcore performance tuning across the entire stack. Optimize Time-To-First-Token (TTFT), Time-To-First-Audio (TTFA), and Real-Time Factor (RTF) over phone lines. Implement model quantization, KV cache optimization, dynamic batching, and efficient model serving to minimize latency under heavy concurrent loads.
* **Indic Language Mastery:**
  Lead the development of multilingual systems that natively handle the phonetic and linguistic nuances of Indian languages. Solve complex challenges related to code-switching (e.g., Hindi-English, Telugu-English), regional accents, and low-resource language modeling.
* **Backend & Production Scale:**
  Architect resilient, event-driven backend systems capable of sustaining high-throughput production traffic. Manage stateful asynchronous processes, distributed microservices, and robust data pipelines to ensure zero-downtime deployments and real-time observability.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* **Experience Baseline:**
  8+ years of overall software engineering and AI/ML experience, with a strict minimum of 3+ years directly architecting and deploying agentic LLM systems and complex conversational AI in production.
* **Production System Expertise:**
  Deep understanding of backend engineering for high-concurrency environments. Proven experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka), workflow orchestrators (e.g., Temporal), and high-performance databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, ClickHouse).
* **Conversational AI Depth:**
  Strong operational knowledge of speech processing models (ASR/TTS) and streaming protocols (WebRTC, gRPC, WebSockets). You must know how to handle endpointing, stream buffering, and state management for natural voice interactions.
* **Optimization & Serving:**
  Hands-on experience with high-performance inference servers (e.g., vLLM, NVIDIA Triton, TensorRT) and optimization techniques for large-scale model deployment.
* **Client to Code Translation:**
  Demonstrated ability to act as a technical architect who can sit with stakeholders, map out domain-specific workflows (e.g., public grievance handling, CRM automation), and model them into reliable AI agents.

Bonus / Preferred Qualifications

* **Deep Telephony Infrastructure:**
  Hands-on experience with bare-metal VoIP networks, custom SIP trunks, and RTP streaming. Familiarity with managing and configuring PBX systems like Asterisk or FreeSWITCH, and handling the network latency and jitter inherent to low-level telecom systems.

Ideal Technical Stack

* **Languages:**
  Python, C++, Go (for high-performance backend components)
* **AI/ML:**
  PyTorch, vLLM, HuggingFace, LangChain/LlamaIndex, specialized ASR/TTS frameworks
* **Telephony & Audio:**
  WebRTC, standard telecom APIs (Twilio/Exotel), standard audio encoding (8kHz µ-law/A-law)
* **Backend & Infrastructure:**
  Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, Apache Kafka, Temporal, Redis, PostgreSQL
* **Observability:**
  Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry (focusing on sub-millisecond tracing for audio/text pipelines)

title: Senior DevOps Architect
description:
**About the Role**

Join SBS as a Senior DevOps Architect for Digital Core, a strategic product portfolio supporting mission-critical banking operations and real-time transaction processing. You will own the platform architecture and engineering practices that turn product innovation into secure, repeatable and operable software across SaaS, public-cloud, private-cloud and customer-controlled environments. The mandate goes beyond tooling: create an industrialised product-delivery platform that improves engineering speed, production resilience, compliance evidence and the economics of operating software at scale.

**This is a senior, high-impact technical leadership role with clear hands-on accountability: you will guide architecture and tackle technical debt, but also use modern enterprise-approved AI tools such as Claude, Codex and equivalent code models to produce deliverable platform components, automation, infrastructure code, pipeline assets and engineering patterns directly.z**

**Why This Role Matters**

Power a strategic product platform. Build the delivery and runtime foundations for Digital Core as SBS expands modular products and SaaS deployments and advances towards a more recurring, scalable software model.

**Operate where reliability has real consequences.**
Engineer platforms for regulated, high-volume and time-critical financial services, including instant and account-to-account payments.

**Make progressive transformation possible.**
Enable banks to introduce modular capabilities and run new repeatable environments, controlled releases and strong operational guardrails.

Create leverage across engineering. Convert security, observability, deployment, compliance and cost-control patterns into reusable self-service capabilities. Improve engineering throughput without trading away resilience, governance or customer choice of deployment model.

**Shape AI-enabled software delivery.**
Operationalise governed use of modern AI models across infrastructure code, pipelines, testing, incident learning and documentation, while retaining deterministic controls and accountable human approval.

**What You Will Do**

**Architect enterprise DevOps platforms.**
Design scalable, reliable and cost-aware architectures across AWS, hybrid and multi-cloud patterns where they create clear value.

**Drive CI/CD excellence.**
Standardise secure delivery pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Argo CD and related tooling, with progressive delivery, rollback and zero-downtime deployment strategies.

**Automate infrastructure.**
Lead infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, Ansible, Helm and cloud-native templates. Establish reusable modules, policy controls and automated validation.

**Apply AI-assisted DevOps.**
Use the latest approved AI models to generate and improve pipeline definitions, infrastructure code, policy-as-code, automation scripts, runbooks, test scenarios and architecture documentation.

**Build safe AI workflows.**
Evaluate generated outputs for correctness, security, permissions, destructive actions, cost and maintainability. Protect secrets and confidential data, require peer review, and keep deterministic testing and audit trails.

**Engineer for real-time payments.**
Design deployment, scaling, resilience and recovery patterns for always-on transaction processing, including controlled degradation, idempotency-aware operations and rapid restoration.

**Support flexible deployment.**
Establish common platform patterns across SaaS, public cloud, private cloud and customer-operated environments without fragmenting engineering standards or compliance evidence.

**Champion governance and DevSecOps.**
Define guardrails, standards and controls aligned with GDPR, PCI DSS and PSD2. Integrate security scanning, provenance, approvals and compliance evidence into delivery workflows.

**Lead container platforms.**
Drive Kubernetes and Docker architecture, workload scaling, tenancy, service discovery, Helm packaging and microservices deployment patterns.

**Improve reliability and observability.**
Implement metrics, logs, traces and alerting using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK and cloud-native services. Apply SRE practices, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident response and resilience testing.

**Advance platform engineering.**
Create self-service golden paths and paved-road capabilities that improve developer experience while maintaining governance.

**Deliver hands-on technical outcomes.**
Personally design, write, review and ship meaningful platform assets, including infrastructure modules, CI/CD templates, automation scripts, policy checks, runbooks and reference implementations. This is not a hands-off advisory role.

**Lead AI-enabled ways of working.**
Help teams adopt modern AI-assisted engineering practices, including prompt/context design, code generation, review discipline, validation workflows and safe reuse patterns, so the organisation changes how it delivers rather than simply adding new tools.

**Build technical strength around you.**
Hire, coach and raise the bar for a strong group of hands-on technical engineers and architects, creating a culture where senior people lead by producing, pairing, reviewing and teaching—not only by steering from a distance.

**Technology Landscape**

**Cloud and infrastructure:**
AWS, Terraform, Ansible, Helm and other new technologies.

**Delivery and platform:**
GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Argo CD, Docker, Kubernetes and GitOps.

**Observability:**
Prometheus, Grafana, ELK and CloudWatch; OpenTelemetry experience is advantageous.

**Security and governance:**
DevSecOps, policy-as-code, software supply-chain security, secrets management and regulatory controls.

**Automation and development:**
Python, Go and Bash; APIs and event-driven automation.

**AI-enabled engineering:**
Enterprise-approved coding assistants and frontier models, model evaluation, prompt/context design, secure usage patterns and human-in-the-loop review.

**Qualifications**

**Experience:**
10+ years in IT, including 5+ years in DevOps/platform engineering and 3+ years in an architecture role, with evidence of delivering complex distributed platforms.

**Cloud architecture:**
Deep expertise in at least one major cloud platform and strong working knowledge of multi-cloud and hybrid architecture patterns.

**Infrastructure as code:**
Advanced proficiency with Terraform and Ansible, plus Helm and cloud-native infrastructure templates.

**CI/CD and GitOps:**
Proven ability to design secure, reliable and efficient pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins and Argo CD.

**Kubernetes:**
Expertise in Docker and Kubernetes, including cluster architecture, scaling, workload isolation, upgrades and production operations.

**Security and networking:**
Strong grounding in cloud networking, identity, Linux/system administration, hardening and software supply-chain security.

**SRE and operations:**
Experience with observability, incident response, error budgets, capacity planning, resilience engineering and chaos testing.

**AI fluency:**
Hands-on use of current AI models for DevOps design and code generation, with the ability to benchmark outputs and implement approval, testing, privacy and audit controls.

**Hands-on delivery mindset:**
Demonstrated ability to personally produce production-quality technical deliverables while operating at architect level, rather than relying only on recommendations, governance or delegation.

**Change leadership:**
Experience helping engineering teams shift to new operating models, including AI-assisted development, platform engineering, DevSecOps and disciplined technical debt reduction.

**Leadership:**
Strong communication, stakeholder management and mentoring skills, with the ability to drive alignment across engineering, operations, security and product teams.

**Certifications:**
Relevant cloud, Kubernetes or DevOps certifications are advantageous, such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, CKA or CKAD.

**Success in This Role**

Success means Digital Core can convert roadmap ideas into production outcomes faster and with greater confidence. You will reduce lead time and operational toil, strengthen availability and recovery, make compliance evidence repeatable, improve cloud and platform cost transparency, and establish responsible AI-assisted delivery as a governed engineering capability. Just as importantly, you will demonstrate hands-on technical leadership: producing deliverables yourself, showing teams how to use new AI tools safely and effectively, helping engineers adapt to new ways of working, and building a stronger technical bench through hiring, coaching and high standards.

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an
**AI-first Engineering Lead**
to build and run a high-output engineering team. The team is responsible for customized client development, independent technology projects and workflow automation.

This is not a conventional engineering management role where AI is used only as a productivity tool. The entire mandate is built around an
**AI-native engineering model**
.

AI agents, coding copilots, automated testing, AI-assisted code review, documentation generation, debugging and workflow automation should become the default way the team operates.

You will lead a team of approximately
**7–10 engineers and QA resources**
and deliver approximately
**3–5 new customized projects or programs every month**
, while also supporting existing enterprise applications.

The core objective is:

**Use AI to materially increase engineering output, reduce repetitive manual work and create a predictable, high-quality customization and project-delivery engine.**

**Business Context:**

We build and operate enterprise Loyalty, Promotions, Rewards and Engagement platforms for large brands. Our core platform supports common functionality, but enterprise clients regularly require:

* Additional workflows
* Client-specific business logic
* Integrations
* New modules
* Custom interfaces
* Special reporting
* Independent applications
* New digital experiences
* Functionality not yet available in the standard platform

The Engineering Lead will own the engineering function responsible for delivering these requirements. The role will also take over a substantial part of the technology responsibility that currently depends on individual knowledge holders.

**AI-First Engineering Mandate:**

The most important part of this role is the ability to redesign how engineering work gets done. We want the development lifecycle to increasingly operate through the following flow:

**Requirement → AI-assisted analysis → Solution design → Agentic development → Automated testing → AI-assisted review → Deployment → Monitoring → AI-assisted support**

The Engineering Lead will create workflows where AI handles as much repeatable engineering work as safely possible. This includes:

* Legacy code understanding
* Codebase navigation
* Dependency mapping
* Impact analysis
* Code generation
* Repetitive customization development
* API scaffolding
* Refactoring
* Migration scripts
* Automated test generation
* Regression automation
* Code review
* Documentation
* Security analysis
* Debugging
* Incident diagnosis
* Production support assistance

**Tools may include:**

* Cursor
* Claude
* Copilot
* AI coding agents
* Workflow automation tools
* LLM-based internal engineering agents
* Automated testing and review systems

The ideal candidate should be able to move beyond simple “AI-assisted coding” into
**AI-orchestrated engineering workflows**
.

**Workflow Automation:**

You will identify repetitive engineering and operational workflows that can be automated. Examples include:

* Requirement interpretation
* Technical estimation
* Test case preparation
* Release readiness checks
* Deployment validation
* Log analysis
* Incident triage
* Documentation updates
* Change impact analysis
* Support diagnostics
* Repetitive client customization work

AI and automation should progressively reduce the manual effort required across the full software delivery lifecycle.

**Customized Client Development:**

The team will own all engineering requirements that fall outside the standard capabilities of the core platform. For every requirement, the Engineering Lead must decide whether it should be:

* Handled through configuration
* Developed once as a reusable platform capability
* Built as a controlled customization
* Delivered as a separate, independent application

**The Engineering Lead will own:**

* Requirement understanding
* Technical solutioning
* Architecture
* Estimation
* Sprint planning
* Resource allocation
* Development
* Code review
* QA
* Deployment
* Production stabilization

Multiple client projects will run in parallel.

**Independent Projects:**

The team will also deliver technology projects that may sit outside the existing core platform. These may include:

* Client portals
* Workflow applications
* Microsites
* API integrations
* Dashboards
* Campaign technologies
* Automation tools
* Internal productivity systems
* Experimental products

The Engineering Lead should be comfortable choosing the right architecture and stack instead of forcing every requirement into the existing monolith.

**Current Technology Environment:**

The current platform includes:

* PHP / Yii
* Angular
* Ionic / mobile components
* PostgreSQL
* APIs and third-party integrations
* Queue and asynchronous processing
* Enterprise client applications
* A largely monolithic architecture
* Multiple historic client-specific customizations

The environment is being modernized progressively. The person joining must be comfortable working with an existing monolith, improving it pragmatically, and using AI to understand and extend it efficiently. This is not a greenfield-only role.

**Team Leadership:**

The Engineering Lead will manage approximately
**7–10 engineers, QA and technical resources**
and will be expected to actively drive:

* Engineering productivity
* Sprint planning
* Resource allocation
* Delivery commitments
* Technical reviews
* Architecture
* Code quality
* QA quality
* Production readiness
* AI adoption
* Workflow automation
* Individual accountability

The person must stay close enough to the work to know:

* What each engineer is building

title: Senior Engineering Manager- NKP
description:
**About The Team**
The NKP (Nutanix Kubertenes Platform) team is building an enterprise-grade management platform for the containerized world. We are developing a fully cloud-native architecture designed to securely deploy, run, and manage Kubernetes clusters seamlessly across any hybrid or multi-cloud environment.
  
  
NKP offers Container Attached Storage using Kubernetes pods to run AOS distributed storage fabric (Cloud Native AOS), enabling seamless integration with cloud native stateful workloads. The platform offers scale out, resilient and tiered storage. Supports storage features such as dynamic provisioning, thin provisioning, data efficiency, and application-centric snapshots. Cloud Native AOS can be used in both hyperconverged and disaggregated storage environments in a hybrid cloud environment. The stateful application Pods use the Nutanix CSI driver to consume storage entities that the AOS Pods present as Persistent Volumes. Much Like an on-premise HCI setup, Cloud Native AOS too provides all core Nutanix data management and copy data management functionalities.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Engineering Manager who is a “builder” at heart—someone who can architect complex storage software and, more importantly, architect the careers of the engineers who write it.
  
  
In this role, you will lead a team of talented junior and mid-level engineers. You will serve as the technical anchor and mentor, guiding the team through the challenges of containerizing our services while ensuring our storage control path remains the gold standard for performance and reliability.
  
  
You will design secure-by-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Cloud-Native Development: Design and build advanced Kubernetes Controllers, Operators, and CRDs in Golang to natively orchestrate and secure storage workloads
* Architect, design and develop storage software for a computing+storage platform, Storage for AI - for cloud native environment.
* Distributed Systems Engineering: Tackle complex problems in large-scale distributed systems, focusing on performance, scaling out, and resiliency.
* Improve data path performance, scale-out and resiliency of our distributed control plane.
* Work closely with other development teams, testers, documentation writers and product management to deliver high-quality products in a fast-paced environment.
* Engage with customers and support when needed to solve production issues
* Technical Leadership: Drive architectural reviews, establish secure coding standards, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers to act as a technical force multiplier.

**What You Will Bring**

* Experience: 12-18 years of software engineering experience and 2+ years of team management, with a proven track record of building large-scale distributed systems, cloud native platforms, or cloud infrastructure.
* Storage Fundamentals: Solid conceptual and practical understanding of distributed storage systems (block, file, object), data replication, deduplication, and high availability. Understanding of the storage access protocols and features viz. SCSI/iSCSI/NFS/CIFS/S3/Cloud. Familiarity with x86 architecture, virtualization and/or storage management.
* Kubernetes Expertise: Deep expertise in Golang and extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes internals, building Operators/Controllers, Container Storage Interface (CSI), CNI, SCCs, MCS preferred
* Systems Engineering: Strong background in Linux OS internals, networking, container runtimes (containerd, Docker), file systems, database back-ends, distributed storage systems and cloud based storage technologies. Experience with Hadoop, MapReduce, Cassandra, Zookeeper and other large-scale distributed systems preferred
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

Work Arrangement

: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. This role will be accountable for building and maintaining scalable data pipelines from source systems. The Data Engineering Manager will ensure the availability, reliability, and performance of data products by integrating raw data from various sources. Key responsibilities include data modeling, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) development, and ensuring data quality and security. This role will be accountable for data coming in from 5+ source systems.

**Job Description: ServiceNow Consultant – CMDB and Platform Capabilities**
**Your role**
As Consultant, IT ServiceNow, you will help mature and scale Vantive’s ServiceNow platform capabilities during the spin-off program and ongoing post-separation operations. The initial focus of this role will be strengthening the Configuration Management Database (CMDB), including data quality, governance, integrations, CSDM alignment, and service-aware mappings. Over time, this consultant should be able to broaden across ServiceNow technologies and related IT process domains, contributing to platform strategy, roadmap execution, operational excellence, and business value realization. This role requires strong technical depth, consultative problem solving, adaptive learning, leadership, and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and third-party service providers.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Lead the maturation of ServiceNow CMDB capabilities, including configuration item data quality, class and relationship modeling, lifecycle governance, reconciliation, normalization, and alignment to the Common Service Data Model (CSDM).
* Partner with infrastructure, application, security, and operations teams to improve discovery, service mapping, integrations, and dependency data that support incident, change, asset, risk, and operational processes.
* Provide tool-agnostic expertise across IT process domains, including IT Service Management, IT Operations Management, and IT Asset Management
* Contribute to the ServiceNow platform roadmap by identifying practical opportunities to improve governance, automation, usability, maintainability, compliance, and return on investment.
* Design, configure, test, and enhance ServiceNow solutions that improve service quality, security, compliance, speed, and operational efficiency.
* Mature development, testing, release, documentation, and support practices for the ServiceNow platform, including clear handoffs to operational support teams.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions by engaging stakeholders, clarifying requirements, documenting user stories, and recommending fit-for-purpose approaches.
* Support platform security and compliance by applying appropriate access controls, secure configuration practices, auditability, and data protection considerations.
* Lead and coordinate third-party solution providers, ensuring deliverables are clearly defined, aligned to Vantive standards, and completed with appropriate quality and accountability.

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, management information systems, business, or a related field required.
* 7+ years of experience in technology, engineering, IT operations, or related roles, including hands-on experience administering, configuring, or implementing the ServiceNow platform.
* Strong ServiceNow CMDB experience, including CI class structures, relationship modeling, data quality, governance, reconciliation, normalization, and lifecycle processes.
* Experience with CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping, MID Servers, integrations, or ITOM capabilities strongly preferred.
* Ability to learn and apply broader ServiceNow capabilities across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, SPM, HRSD, reporting, workflow automation, and platform governance.
* Experience delivering solutions in a highly regulated, global business environment.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with business, technology, security, and vendor teams while holding service providers accountable for delivery.
* Strong analytical, technical, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to diagnose complex platform, process, data, and integration issues.
* Strong communication, facilitation, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset, with a willingness to broaden skills across ServiceNow technologies and connected enterprise platforms.
* Previous large transformation, separation, merger, or platform modernization program experience desired.
* Experience mentoring platform engineers, administrators, analysts, or vendor resources desired.
* ServiceNow certifications desired, especially Certified System Administrator, CIS-CMDB, CIS-Discovery, CIS-Service Mapping, ITSM, ITOM, or related certifications.
